The contact panel of a party (consent state and verification of contact points) is served through a gateway-bff composite route published here; its screen identifier, field list and masking are not specified in the source documents (GAP-2379) and are left to the case record view story and the edge contract. SCR-33 Template approval stays with the template stories of the same service. The gateway-bff composite route list is the route list of this contract, and the service template reads that list and adds no route of its own. The per-service module map file is not specified in the source documents (GAP-1430).
